==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson explains to me that he's a historian. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.)
He has been having dreams about the legendary wielder of the Gold Trident who saved the underwater city from alien Were-Sharks. (Were-Fish Society resembles an underwater city made up of glowing, orange, glass, dome shaped pods. There are orange roadways that weave throughout the city, that allow for cars to navigate between the underwater domes. The city is located underwater deep in a river beneath a bridge in the Elven Village.) (The Gold Trident Wielder is a flying, sparkling golden, faceless humanoid wielding a glowing, magical, golden trident.) (Were-Sharks resemble humanoid sharks.)
The wielder's identity and whereabouts are unknown.
